description: Documentation for the ALNStudios Minecraft Bedrock add-on monorepo: Bedrock guide, AI coding rules and review standards, and script and workflow summaries.
rules: Target Minecraft Bedrock 1.21 and newer. Use @minecraft/server and @minecraft/server-ui 2.x stable only; take exact versions from retrieved text and say 'not verified' when a version is not in it. Never use mojang-minecraft, world.events or 1.x syntax.

One Batch Query Per Needed Library (Parallel Only): group all required lookups for a library into at most ONE query-docs call per relevant libraryId (for example, one call for /microsoftdocs/minecraft-creator covering all needed APIs, plus one call for /allenscreations/mcpe-curseforges covering all needed repo rules). Execute those calls together in a single parallel turn. Never make multiple calls to the same libraryId and never run sequential retry loops.

This repository is indexed from docs/ only: docs/bedrock-guide.md (architecture, folders, manifests, API versions), docs/instructions-reference.md (all coding rules and review standards), docs/scripts-and-workflows.md (scripts and workflows), docs/mcicons-index.md (Minecraft icon ids in MCicons).
Pack updates deliver a self-contained <Project>_v<Version>_<Rand>.sh update script built with scripts/make_update_script.py (embedded payload, ANSI status UI, auto-rebase, commit, push, and cleanup).

Custom audio is synthesized via pure-Python <project>/sound_sources/make_sounds.py (.ogg output, ffmpeg dependency, format_version 1.14.0 sound_definitions.json, aln.<project>.<element>.<kind> sound events, and player-facing description rules).

Docs rules (DOCS_RULES.md): commercial, player-first showcase tone, relative image paths only, pre-rendered PNG crafting grids (never HTML/CSS), no emojis, mobile-optimized card styling, zero developer clutter in player docs.
Never edit generated files: builds/, Package/, changelog_views/, MCPEDL/AI Review/, MCPEDL/README.md.
Scripts that must run need their complete file text from the kit zip; a documentation summary is not enough.
